mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200k in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this interaction-driven signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY signals strong supply-side momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when INDPRO YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth below 2% QoQ indicates sluggish demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during slowdowns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50bps in a single month signals monetary tightening, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 50bps.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp in 2 months and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to less than 100k, the combined labor market weakness predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise > 0.5pp in 2 months and PAYEMS growth < 100k
failure_condition: Rank IC for this interaction-driven signal remains below 0.03 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) growth below 3% YoY indicates weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during holiday seasons are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS YoY growth < 3% (t-test p > 0.1).
